aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misgroups the Ralon vs GES supplier comparison and several outcome pairings.
issues: Changed factor should be Ralon improved CD lot/vendor vs normal GES CD, not equipment.
Changed condition incorrectly includes aggregate label Total.
Function outcome pairs compare C2 and total Ralon rows against the E2 GES baseline instead of matching C2 and total GES rows.
Measurement outcomes are header/formula artifacts and should be removed.
Vision outcomes need clearer metric labels and handling of vision abnormal versus total NG.
correctionPlan: Set change domain to material/supplier and define baseline as normal GES CD, test as improved Ralon CD.
Keep E2, C2, total, AWF machine #1, and test stage as subgroup context.
Repair function pairs: E2 rows 33/35, C2 rows 37/39, total rows 41/43.
Remove non-evidence measurement artifacts from rows 32 and 36.
Recheck vision rows 14/15 and 27/28 for total NG and vision abnormal interpretations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited grouping is not sufficient for final evidence.
